title: Slovakian Hash Browns
description: A hearty, crispy dish inspired by Slovakian cuisine, made with potato and earthy flavors.
instructions: Grate the potatoes and squeeze out excess moisture.
Mix with smoked paprika, hash browns seasoning, and salt.
Divide the mixture into 2 equal parts.
Shape each part into a rectangular shape.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the egg to the pan and scramble it.
Add the hash brown mixture to the pan and press down.
Cook for 4-5 minutes, flip, and cook for another 4-5 minutes.
Slice into wedges and serve hot.
